(2) A teenage girl in a white and black baseball-style shirt and black pants enters the frame from the left, walking past the boy. The boy quickly crouches down on the grey brick path as if reacting to her presence, then stands up as she moves away. He repeats this rhythmic gesture with a focused expression as yellow and blue captions appear below him. (4) The scene shifts to another part of the park featuring green metal outdoor fitness equipment. The boy and girl walk side-by-side along a concrete path. The boy continues his crown-and-wide-arm gesture sequence while walking, maintaining a disciplined pace alongside the girl. (5) In a final close-up near the gym equipment, the boy stands firmly on the black rubber ground. He gives a sharp military salute with his right hand to his forehead, then transitions into his signature circular crown gesture over his head, looking directly at the viewer.
